title: RCA Response Schema
description: Structured response for Incident Root Cause Analysis results

rootCause.description: The most probable root cause based on grounded historical evidence. Must come from historical incident data, never invented.

rootCauseCategory.description: High-level category of the root cause

confidence.description: Confidence level in the root cause determination (0-100). 90-100: strong specific match, 65-79: broad input with probable cause, 0: no meaningful match

matchedIncidentIds.description: Array of historical incident IDs that support this root cause. Must be exact IDs from the retrieval tool output. Can be empty if confidence is 0.

relatedChangeId.description: Related change record ID if changeCorrelation is true, otherwise empty string. Must be exact ID from tool output.

changeCorrelation.description: True only if a related change was found with supporting evidence (changeSupported: true from tool). False if no change, or change does not support the root cause.

evidence.description: List of evidence statements supporting the root cause determination. Each item should be a concise factual statement from the retrieval tool output.
